reviewer: primary coding agent; direct source review, no local Ollama judge

rubric.faithfulness: Supported atomic factual assertions / all factual assertions; use retrieved evidence only.
rubric.answer_correctness: Mean per-answer factual-precision/required-fact-recall F1 across the 15 answerable cases; unsupported factual certainty is unverified, not correct.
rubric.citation_accuracy: Citations supporting the entire associated claim in their own excerpt context AND matching original-source provenance / all citations.
rubric.abstention_accuracy: Correct answered/insufficient-evidence decisions across all 20 cases, including false-abstention checks.
rubric.atomic_decomposition: Keep entity/value/condition relations intact; split separately asserted conjuncts. Retain extra supported advice as factual assertions; it cannot replace required facts.
rubric.qualifiers: Distinguish requested/configured certificate validity from actual issued validity. Case 04 is conservatively marked unsupported/unknown, not a wrong numeric value.
